programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. Along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau. Chris and Casey are on the search for some large bucks, as well as showing the people at the camp a great time and what deer season is all about.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.desc: Jakob Nowell, frontman of Sublime and Jakob’s Castle, joins Joel Madden for an open conversation on legacy, sobriety, and finding identity beyond fame. Jakob reflects on growing up surrounded by music, his father’s influence, building his own sound, and the healing power of honesty in art.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Producer/guitarist Josh Carter—one half of genre-bending duo Phantogram—joins host Joel Madden to talk about why trying too hard can kill the art, his creative/lifelong bond with bandmate Sarah Barthel, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. From upstate New York origins to Brooklyn and now L.A., Josh digs into collaboration culture, beat-making roots, Big Grams with Big Boi, and the hip-hop influences (Beastie Boys, Wu-Tang, Public Enemy) that shaped his sound—plus a little baseball talk (Mets, Dodgers, Orioles).

programme.title: King 810: Memoirs Livestream From The Crofoot Ballroom
programme.desc: King 810 performs Memoirs of a Murderer live in full for the first time since 2014 in an intense concert filmed at the Crofoot Ballroom.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Vishen Lakhiani, founder and CEO of Mindvalley, joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on mindfulness, compassion, and redefining success. Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: DEVO: 50 Years of De-Evolution…Live!

programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Foxing: Live at The Grandel

programme.title: Judas Priest: Epitaph
programme.desc: Judas Priest performs a powerful final tour set at Hammersmith Apollo, featuring songs spanning their 40-year career.

programme.title: Boys Like Girls: The Soundtrack of your life tour

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Stephan Jenkins of Third Eye Blind on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Third Eye Blind frontman Stephan Jenkins joins Joel Madden to discuss songwriting, creativity, and the band’s upcoming album. Jenkins opens up about perfectionism, the struggle to finish lyrics, and the human element that drives his music. He also shares insights on producing, the influence of Eric Valentine, and gearing up for The Summer Gods Tour with Yellowcard and A R I Z O N A.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sam Carter, the powerhouse vocalist of Architects, for a candid conversation about gut instincts, creative integrity, and nearly two decades of building one of heavy music’s most influential bands. Sam opens up about his serendipitous bond with Good Charlotte, the “say yes or say no” mindset that guides his decisions, and how gratitude—and a little British self-deprecation—keep him grounded. He reflects on Warped Tour dreams turned stadium reality, the band’s tight-knit dynamic, and why this era is about smiling more, having fun, and bringing the wide-eyed 13-year-old version of himself back on stage. They also talk about Architects’ new album, The Sky, The Earth & All Between (out Feb 28), aiming to make their 11th record their biggest and most honest yet.

programme.title: Amar No Es Querer
programme.desc: Tras un accidente, Samuel queda en coma. Jackie halla un nuevo sentido apoyando a niños con cáncer y conoce el amor otra vez. Cuando Samuel despierta con amnesia y vuelve a enamorarse, Jackie debe elegir entre lo que construyó y su primer amor.

programme.title: Mágico Amor
programme.desc: La curandera Apolena encuentra a Zito, un bebé abandonado quien, con el tiempo, se convierte en un joven bondadoso. Sin embargo, las fuerzas del mal se conjuran en su contra.

programme.title: L'Aventura de Murphy
programme.desc: "Just Jesse the Jack" recluta a un grupo de jóvenes detectives y a su padre, presentador de un popular programa de televisión, para ayudarlo a desentrañar el misterio detrás de sus talentos telepáticos. Pero las cosas se vuelven aún más misteriosas cuando se ven envueltos en un mundo de ovnis y agentes secretos.

programme.title: Bilal: La Leyenda de un Héroe
programme.desc: Hace mil años, un niño con el sueño de convertirse en un gran guerrero es secuestrado junto a su hermana y llevado a una tierra lejos de casa. Arrojado a un mundo lleno de injusticias, Bilal encuentra el coraje para alzar la voz y cambiar las cosas.

programme.title: Lo que de Verdad Importa
programme.desc: Un joven descubre que tiene don de curar, lo que transforma su vida. Mientras intenta comprender este poder y su nueva realidad, se encuentra con una adolescente con cáncer terminal, quien le enseña lecciones profundas sobre la vida y la esperanza.

programme.title: Amar No Es Querer

programme.title: El Conde de Montecristo
programme.desc: Edmundo Dantés es falsamente acusado por los celos de otros por su buena fortuna y es condenado a pasar el resto de su vida en la famosa prisión de la isla, Chateau d'lf. Mientras encarcelado, se encuentra con Abbe Faria, un compañero de prisión a quien todo el mundo cree que estar loco. Abbe Faria le dice a Edmundo de un tesoro fantástico escondido en una pequeña isla que sólo él conoce la ubicación. Después de muchos años de prisión, el viejo Abbe muere y Edmundo escapa disfrazado como el cuerpo. Ahora libre, Edmundo debe encontrar el tesoro de Abbe le contó, para que pueda vengarze de aquellos que lo han hecho mal.

programme.title: Jim Morrison - Rock Poet
programme.desc: Jim Morrison was a wonderful by product of 1950's era of a new breed of artists: self-titled intellectuals and modern-day philosophers, gathering in coffee houses in New York, San Francisco and Paris reading Beat Poetry. programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un furioso Joe lucha contra una suspensión federal que le impedirá transportar pasajeros por primera vez en 20 años. También es un revés para Jeremy y las otras rampas, que empeora con una lesión inesperada. Para el equipo de waterbomber de Turquía, finalmente es una oportunidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de la amarga partida de su esposo de Buffalo, Kelly tiene una confrontación que decide si ella también renunciará. Jeremy comete un error que podría terminar con su carrera en Buffalo. La escasez de gasolina de aviación trae una dosis de realidad aleccionadora a los McBryans. Y después de una visita de su madre, el destino le lanza a Scott una inesperada bola curva.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Superpitufo
programme.desc: Gigantón roba el suministro de alimentos de invierno y de los Pitufos y Pitufo Filósofo prepara una de las pociones de fortaleza de Papá Pitufo para que pueda luchar contra el codicioso gigante. La súper fórmula desaparece, pero Papá Pitufo hace un cambio rápido, cambia la comida por piedras y Gigantón sale perdiendo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La malvada bruja se transforma en Pitufo para vengarse de ellos por destruir su amuleto mágico.

programme.title: El Bebé Pitufo
programme.desc: Gargamel se transforma en un Bebé Pitufo, para ser adoptado por los Pitufos. Causa un completo caos en la Aldea de los Pitufos cuando intenta hacerlos volar por los aires con una bomba. Papá Pitufo descubre su malvado plan y utiliza el explosivo para enviar al mago de vuelta a su deprimente castillo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las provisiones de comida de los Pitufos para el invierno se estropea y preparan un viaje hasta un lejano castillo en el que pueden refugiarse. Al principio, creen que el castillo está embrujado, pero tras descubrir que sólo se trata de un grupo de ratas, el propietario del castillo les obsequia comida en abundancia para el largo invierno.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Morados
programme.desc: La mosca morada muerde a Pitufo Perezoso, provocando una epidemia en el pueblo que convertirá a todos en furiosos Pitufos morados. Papá Pitufo descubre que el polen de una flor del bosque es el antídoto y pronto las cosas volverán a pitufar como siempre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Filósofo crea una poción que hace que Fortachón crezca de tamaño humano.

programme.title: Ahora Los Pitufeas Y Ahora No
programme.desc: Los troles subterráneos capturan a los Pitufos para que sean sus esclavos. Papá Pitufo ingeniosamente los libera y luego destruye la bola de cristal mágica que les concede el poder sobre los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para tratar de descubrir dónde se encuentra el escondite secreto de diamantes de los Pitufos, Gargamel finge ser su amigo. Cuando muestra su verdadera naturaleza malvada, Papá Pitufo conjura un hechizo mágico para salvar a sus pequeños Pitufos de las garras maliciosas del mago malvado.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Perezoso sueña que está en la Isla Paraíso y libre de todo el trabajo que Papá Pitufo le impone. Su fantasía se vuelve una pesadilla que lo hace volver a trabajar nuevamente con afán.

programme.title: La Abominable Bestia De La Nieve
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y sus amigos organizan una jornada en la Montaña de Hielo para buscar la rara flor de la nieve para Papá Pitufo. Encuentran una terrorífica bestia de la nieve, pero acaban siendo amigos gracias a la amabilidad de Pitufina, y les ayuda a encontrar la minúscula flor.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina ha encontrado a una nueva amiga, Laura, una niña de seis años de edad cuyos padres viven cerca del bosque. Juntas, las dos niñas se pasean por el bosque. Pero una vieja bruja que vive en el bosque las captura.

programme.title: Educando A Goloso
programme.desc: Pitufo Goloso se excede. Se pone cada vez más pesado hasta que su peso lo pone en peligro. El malvado Gargamel va a atraparlo... ¿Pitufo Goloso podrá ser salvado por Papá Pitufo?

programme.title: El Dia Del Amor
programme.desc: Ha llegado el Día de San Valentín. La bruja Hogata se encuentra junto al estanque recogiendo plantas cuando, por accidente, una de las flechas de Cupido impacta en ella. Ahora, se enamorará perdidamente del primer hombre que se cruce en su camino… y, contra todo pronóstico, ese hombre es el mismo Gargamel. ¿Conseguirá que ella atrape a todos los Pitufos de un plumazo? ¿Y conseguirá Hogata librarse del hechizo de amor?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La vida en la Aldea Pitufa podría ser más tranquila si Puppy se comportara un poco mejor. Sin embargo, el pequeño perro de los Pitufos se dedica a escarbar entre las flores de Pitufina, ensuciar el nuevo papel pintado de Pitufo Vanidoso y arruinar los experimentos de Papá Pitufo. Aun así, Puppy va a ayudar a los Pitufos a escapar de una trampa que les ha tendido Gargamel. O quizá no tenga la disciplina necesaria para ello…

programme.title: El Pitufo Galante
programme.desc: La reina Agripina no dejará que su hijo, el príncipe Godofredo, se case con la dulce Priscila. Ella quiere como nuera a una chica que sea capaz de mostrarle algo que nunca antes haya visto. Cuando Hogata se entera y descubre la existencia de Abuelo Pitufo, está segura de que logrará sorprender a la reina con su captura. Por supuesto, Hogata debe atrapar primero a Abuelo Pitufo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está harto. Los Pitufitos y Sasita siguen inventándose historias sobre él con desagradables consecuencias. Por eso, prepara una fórmula mágica, extraída del libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo, que hace que los pequeños Pitufos crezcan y crezcan cada vez que dicen mentiras. Pero no había contado con que ahora Gargamel tiene una forma de capturar a los Pitufitos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una emergencia, todos los Pitufos de la aldea dejan lo que tienen entre manos y corren a oír las noticias. Pero que Pitufo Vanidoso convoque una asamblea para que los Pitufos puedan admirar su nuevo gorro es pasarse de la raya. Le echan de la aldea y Pitufo Vanidoso tiene la mala suerte de encontrarse con Lofty, el elfo, que le recomienda darse un horrible baño de fango…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué es esa extraña rana parlante que ha hecho que el hechicero Morlock haya enviado a todos los soldados del príncipe Teodoro para capturarla? ¿Es una rana demonio, como él dice? ¿O quizá lo hace por otro motivo? La verdad se desvelará cuando Pitufina y los Pitufitos se encuentran con la rana. Ayudan a la rana a volver a transformarse en el príncipe Teodoro, que había sido víctima de un hechizo lanzado por Morlock.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada 500 años, el Castillo Prisión aparece y secuestra a inocentes viajeros. Abuelo Pitufo despega en su globo hacia el castillo, donde se encuentra con Nana Pitufa, que lleva desaparecida 500 años. Tienen poco tiempo para escapar; de lo contrario, ¡se convertirán en invitados permanentes!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Tierra De Los Objetos Perdidos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón, Pitufo Carpintero y Pitufo Filósofo pierden el telescopio de Papá Pitufo y Scour, el señor de los objetos perdidos, lo encuentra. Los Pitufos le dicen que darían cualquier cosa por recuperarlo, y Scour se apropia así de sus posesiones más preciadas: su fortaleza, su habilidad y su inteligencia. Entonces, viajan hasta sus dominios para recuperar lo que han perdido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Némesis aparece en la Biblioteca de los Magos para robar el conocimiento de los Archivos del Mal y hacerse con la Piedra de la Longevidad. Pero Pitufo Filósofo salva la situación sin darse cuenta, ya que cambia el libro de cocina de Pitufo Goloso por el libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina y Nana Pitufa comparten casa y se sacan de quicio la una a la otra, así que ha llegado el momento de que Nana Pitufa tenga su propia casa. Mientras Nana Pitufa y Pitufina salen en busca de una planta calienta hogares, los demás diseñan la casa más pitufantástica posible para ella.

programme.title: No Puedo Pitufar La Música
programme.desc: No hay nada que la hechicera Clorhidris odie tanto como el amor en el mundo. Le gustaría que el amor desapareciera de la faz de la tierra y, para conseguirlo, ha decidido comenzar por la música. Lanza un hechizo a un cuerno mágico que absorberá la melodía de las canciones… en especial, de las canciones de los Pitufos. Con la ayuda de su amiga Laconia, es posible que los Pitufos consigan echar por tierra el malvado plan de Clorhidris…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos…

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: No todos los días se encuentra uno con una flor parlante. Y, en especial, con un personaje como Petaluma, una planta bulbosa algo arrogante con la que Pitufina se encuentra en el bosque. Por supuesto, Pitufina se muestra encantada y lleva a Petaluma con ella a la Aldea Pitufa… desencadenando un proceso que pondrá en peligro a todos los Pitufos. Parece que las flores están hechas para contemplarlas y no para escucharlas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos pueden cometer errores. Incluso Papá Pitufo. Su nuevo pulverizador para potenciar el perfume hace que una rosa huela como un millar de ellas… pero, debido a una serie de desafortunados sucesos, también hace llorar a todos los Pitufos, que se deshacen en lágrimas a la mínima. Mientras sollozan, berrean, se lamentan, gimen y lloriquean, el malvado mago Gargamel pasa a la acción…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Esta noche es el espectáculo de talentos en la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo va a hacer trucos de magia, Sasita actuará con su sapo mascota amaestrado, Pitufo Torpe intentará hacer malabarismos… y Pitufo Bromista ha hecho un muñeco de Gargamel y está seguro de que hará temblar de miedo a los Pitufos. Sin embargo, el auténtico Gargamel encuentra una forma de dar vida al muñeco de Pitufo Bromista, y entonces…

programme.title: Sorpresa Para Sassette
programme.desc: A veces, los pequeños actos pueden tener grandes consecuencias. Mientras intentaba atrapar a Sasita, Gargamel altera la Balanza de la Verdad y, desde ese momento, todos los habitantes del mundo comienzan a mentir. Incluso Papá Pitufo se ha convertido en un mentiroso compulsivo. Y, por si eso fuera poco, el espíritu de la balanza ha encadenado juntos a Gargamel y Sasita, que deberán volver a colocar en su sitio el Topacio de la Verdad…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Bebé Pitufo ha perdido el interés por los juguetes. Ni siquiera las sorpresas de Pitufo Bromista consiguen entretener al pequeño. Abuelo Pitufo propone hacer una visita al Juguetero, el encargado de fabricar juguetes para los niños de todo el mundo. O más bien, el que los fabricaba: el Juguetero está cansado del poco aprecio que demuestran por sus juguetes aquellos que los reciben.

programme.title: La Pitufivisión De Genio
programme.desc: Pitufo Minero rebusca bajo todas las piedras y, gracias a ello, descubre un cristal que transmite imágenes. Esto permite a Pitufo Carpintero inventar la pitufivisión y, desde ese momento, los Pitufos pueden ver todas las mañanas los entrenamientos de Pitufo Fortachón, los informes de las cosechas de Pitufo Labrador e incluso el programa de Pitufo Filósofo. Pero ¿quién podría haberlo imaginado? ¡El malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la pitufivisión para atrapar Pitufos!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Ultimo Hechizo De Papa Pitufo
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo ha sido elegido Hechicero del Año, y el malvado mago Gargamel está verde de envidia. Buscará la forma de hacer que los poderes de Papá Pitufo desaparezcan. Entonces, podrá atrapar a todos los Pitufos y celebrarlo con un gran banquete… Ahora bien, ¿permitirá Papá Pitufo que suceda algo tan terrible? Por supuesto que no: Papá Pitufo encontrará la forma de arruinar el plan de Gargamel…

programme.title: El Color Mas Pitufoso
programme.desc: Spectra es el hada de los colores, y con su rueda de los colores crea todos los azules, rojos, amarillos y verdes del mundo. Es amiga de Pitufo Pintor, pero, cuando este lleva a los Pitufitos a su morada en su ausencia, los Pitufitos se ponen a jugar con la rueda de los colores… y provocan que todos los colores desaparezcan de la Tierra. Y, lo que es aún peor: sin colores, el hada de los colores no puede vivir…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Deshollinador se encarga de limpiar las chimeneas y no es precisamente el habitante más popular de la Aldea Pitufa. Es bastante desaliñado, y las nubes de hollín que suelta no contribuyen a aumentar su popularidad. Únicamente los Pitufitos le consideran una excelente compañía, ya que es el único Pitufo que puede ensuciarse sin que le riñan. Sin embargo, el entusiasmo de los Pitufitos por Pitufo Deshollinador pone en peligro la aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Genio inventa una máquina que hará todo el trabajo de cosechar y preparar la comido de los Pitufos. Pero esta milagrosa invención tiene sus bemoles.

programme.title: Pitufos Helados
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos están a punto de sucumbir al intenso frío. ¿Podrá Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una aventura dramática y conmovedora… Pitufina y su mascota Re chillido. La pequeña Pitufina está inundada en lágrimas. ¿Podrán los demás pitufos consolarla?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Soñador desea encontrar vida extraterrestre pero en la Aldea se burlan de él. Nadie le creerá cuando les diga que ha hablado con un ser de otro planeta.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha salvado a Pitufo Torpe de un terrible destino. Pitufo Torpe jura devoción eterna a su salvador y se esfuerza al máximo por saldar su deuda… con consecuencias desastrosas. Se hace necesario idear un plan ingenioso para evitar las bienintencionadas catástrofes causadas por Pitufo Torpe…

programme.title: La Venganza De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Se ha desatado una guerra en la Edad Media. Unos caballeros vestidos con armadura destrozan por accidente la Aldea Pitufa, lo que provoca que una pequeña banda de Pitufos decida vengar esta afrenta. ¿No pensará Papá Pitufo que esta es una acción demasiado propia de los humanos?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo y diabólico plan para librarse de los Pitufos: un polvo brillante que hará que no puedan dejar de reírse…

programme.title: Los Pitufos En El Laberinto
programme.desc: Pitufo Bromista está deseando conocer a Melchor el Magnífico, creador del famoso truco máximo de la desaparición. ¿Conseguirá atrapar Gargamel a los Pitufos en el laberinto fantástico de Melchor?

programme.title: Pitufo Dormilón
programme.desc: El Pitufo Perezoso se está volviendo demasiado dormilón. Los otros Pitufos han decidido gastarle una broma: cuando se despierte, se encontrará rodeado de Pitufos viejos y llenos de arrugas, y le dirán que ha estado dormido durante siglos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Miedoso entra corriendo en la aldea y grita que el cielo se está cayendo. Justo en ese mismo momento, Papá Pitufo está aquejado de un incontrolable ataque de estornudos…

programme.title: El Pitufo Sospechoso
programme.desc: ¿Puedes creer que Pitufo Filósofo condujo al malvado Gargamel hasta la Aldea Pitufa? Por supuesto, él no lo hizo. Sin embargo, los demás sospechan de él…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¡Pitufo Torpe ha desenterrado una extraña piedra! En ella, puede ver los eventos que van a suceder… ¡No obstante, conocer parte del futuro a veces trae mala suerte!

programme.title: Corazón De Oro
programme.desc: No importa lo que diga Pitufo Filósofo: Pitufo Robotín, la creación de Pitufo Carpintero, tiene sentimientos como cualquier Pitufo normal. O al menos eso parece… hasta que Pitufo Robotín pierde aquello que Pitufo Carpintero había colocado en su caja torácica: un corazón de oro. El malvado mago Gargamel y su aprendiz Escrupuloso encuentran al pequeño autómata y le colocan un corazón de piedra, lo que augura malos tiempos para los Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para demostrar lo válido que es su «Gran libro de supervivencia en la naturaleza», Pitufo Filósofo se lleva a los Pitufitos al pantano. Allí, gracias a su experto consejo, el pequeño grupo se extravía, queda atrapado en arenas movedizas y es capturado por el Rey Verrugoso. Afortunadamente, el Rey Verrugoso está con ganas de jugar y decide hacer una caza del Pitufo. Desafortunadamente, Pitufo Filósofo cree que es un líder por naturaleza…

programme.title: Peligro En La Aldea
programme.desc: El pérfido mago Gargamel está harto de la constante superioridad de los Pitufos. Decide destruir su aldea de una vez por todas. Con ese fin, entrena una termita para que destroce, demuela, devaste y destruya todas las casas que se encuentre en su camino. Sin embargo, los efectos son mucho peores de lo que Gargamel había imaginado, ya que los Pitufos creen que las travesuras de los Pitufitos son las que están destruyendo su aldea.

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un duende maligno le pone unos zapatos mágicos a Pitufina, que no puede dejar de bailar, con la intención de que le prometa que se casará con él. Todos sus pequeños amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papá Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos mágicos al duende, obligándole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Poeta y Pintor se sienten poco valorados y huyen a una isla tormentosa sin saber que Gargamel los sigue hasta allí.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Bueno El Malo Y El Pitufo
programme.desc: Un malvado brujo captura a los Pitufos para usarlos en su plan para robar todo el oro del Rey Argón.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que No Podia Decir No
programme.desc: Pitufo Palomo no puede decir que no y eso provoca que todos le encarguen sus tareas. Pronto eso lo llevará a enfrentar un gran peligro.

programme.title: No Puedo Pitufar La Música
programme.desc: No hay nada que la hechicera Clorhidris odie tanto como el amor en el mundo. Le gustaría que el amor desapareciera de la faz de la tierra y, para conseguirlo, ha decidido comenzar por la música. Lanza un hechizo a un cuerno mágico que absorberá la melodía de las canciones… en especial, de las canciones de los Pitufos. Con la ayuda de su amiga Laconia, es posible que los Pitufos consigan echar por tierra el malvado plan de Clorhidris…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos…

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.desc: Nicole Taylor es una princesa mimada que nunca aprendió a ser independiente.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: La ex estrella de atletismo Fatimah Leday se une al ejército y está destinada en Irak, donde conoce a un soldado encantador llamado Carlton.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Jamie Santos es una chica salvaje que se niega a ser domada. Conoce a Jonathan y rápidamente se obsesiona hasta el punto de alejarlo.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)

programme.title: Easy Come, Easy Go
programme.desc: On his last day in the Navy, frogman Elvis discovers a sunken treasure ship. On his first day as a civilian, Elvis starts his new job—self-employed treasure hunter!

programme.title: Roustabout
programme.desc: Elvis is a karate-chopping biker who’s hired as a carnival Roustabout. At first he just provides muscle and a diversion for the beautiful carny girls. Then he picks up a guitar and gets the midway rockin’.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Kickboxer III (The Art Of War)
programme.desc: David Sloan (Mitchell ) travels to Rio de Janeiro where the action is hotter, the women sexier, and the competition deadlier than ever before.

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: The Aggressor
programme.desc: David Sloan is on a mission to free his wife who has been enslaved by an evil world champion, Tong Po. He attempts to gain entry into Po’s savage kingdom by fighting in the tournament of champions where the winner takes all.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Michelle Pfeiffer plays Frankie, a waitress at a N.Y.C. coffee shop. After a series of hurtful relationships, the last thing Frankie’s looking for is a new man...until he comes looking for her.

programme.title: End Of Watch
programme.desc: Officers Brian Taylor (Jake Gyllenhaal) and Mike Zavala (Michael Peña) form a powerful brotherhood to ensure they both go home at the end of their shifts in South Central, Los Angeles.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: From the best-selling book series comes a fantasy adventure that reveals the unseen world all around us.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: In the third creature feature in the MIMIC franchise, the bugs are back. After a group of people begins to disappear, a man hypersensitive to germs and confined to a protective bubble, decides to play detective.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and worst of all, the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Messiah Of Evil
programme.desc: A woman arrives in a seaside town after receiving unsettling letters from her father, only to discover it's under the influence of a strange cult.

programme.title: Dead & Buried
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening in the quiet coastal village of Potters Bluff, where tourists and transients are warmly welcomed... then brutally murdered. But even more shocking is when these slain strangers reappear as normal citizens around town.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Big Jake
programme.desc: An aging Texas cattle man who has outlived his time swings into action when outlaws kidnap his grandson and wound his son.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson ignite the screen in this rousing story of a wealthy Montana rancher who hires a professional killer to track down a gang of horse thieves.

programme.title: The Crow: City of Angels
programme.desc: This fast-moving, action-packed sequel to THE CROW follows the rise of murder victim Ashe Corven, brought back to life by a mysterious crow. With the help of a woman named Sarah, he exacts revenge on his killers one by one.

programme.title: The Crow: Salvation
programme.desc: Alex Corvis returns to the world of the living to solve the murder of a young woman that he was wrongly accused of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: You Can't Run Forever
programme.desc: Suffering from acute anxiety, young Miranda faces a new terror when a serial killer chooses her as his next target. As he chases her through the woods, she soon finds the strength she never knew she had to elude her murderous tracker.

programme.title: Beyond the Reach
programme.desc: In the Mojave Desert, a naked and unarmed hunting guide (Jeremy Irvine) runs from a wealthy hunter (Michael Douglas) who wants to ensure his silence in the death of an old man.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Marshall
programme.desc: About a young Thurgood Marshall, the first African-American Supreme Court Justice, as he battles through one of his career-defining cases.

programme.title: The Inspection
programme.desc: Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool (2018)

programme.title: Source Code

programme.title: Along Came a Spider

programme.title: Hamburger Hill

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Seven complete strangers of widely varying personality characteristics are involuntarily placed in an endless maze containing deadly traps.

programme.title: Mimic

programme.title: Heretic

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee II
programme.desc: Just as the eccentric Australian is starting to adjust to life in New York City, Dundee and his beautiful girlfriend (Linda Kozlowski) are targeted for death by a gang of ruthless drug dealers.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles

programme.title: A Fish Called Wanda (1988)

programme.title: The House of the Devil
programme.desc: Desperate for quick cash, college sophomore Samantha Hughes takes a babysitting job in the isolated mansion of the creepy Ulman family. Samantha has no idea that a nightmare of unspeakable fear and torment awaits her within these walls.

programme.title: The Innkeepers

programme.title: Thunderheart

programme.title: Who's Minding The Store?
programme.desc: An incompetent young man is given a job in a department store by his girlfriend's mother, who hopes to put an end to their romance.

programme.title: Detective Story
programme.desc: Kirk Douglas stars as the rigid detective whose personal code has become twisted from dealing with too many criminals. Eleanor Parker is his wife, tormented by a guilty secret.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Albany Road
programme.desc: On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

programme.title: Kickboxer: Retaliation
programme.desc: When MMA fighter Kurt Sloane is forced into an underground death match with a 400lb drug-enhanced killer, he seeks help from the legendary Master Durand (Jean-Claude Van Damme) and prison fighter Briggs (Mike Tyson) to survive the fight.

programme.title: Kickboxer 2: The Road Back
programme.desc: In this rousing sequel to Kickboxer, Tong Po broods about his defeat at the hands of Kurt Sloan. Po and his managers resort to drastic measures to goad Kurt into the ring for a rematch.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Michelle Pfeiffer plays Frankie, a waitress at a N.Y.C. coffee shop. After a series of hurtful relationships, the last thing Frankie’s looking for is a new man...until he comes looking for her.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Frank and Jesse
programme.desc: After the defeat of the South in the Civil War and the murder of their younger brother, Frank and Jesse James seek their own brand of justice. As outlaws, they gain fame for their daring hold-ups of banks, trains, and stagecoaches.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Alex Rider: Operation Stormbreaker
programme.desc: After his uncle dies, a young boy learns of his relative's true occupation as an undercover spy and is later recruited to be undercover himself. Based on the novel by Anthony Horowitz.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: In the third creature feature in the MIMIC franchise, the bugs are back. After a group of people begins to disappear, a man hypersensitive to germs and confined to a protective bubble, decides to play detective.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: Mob Town
programme.desc: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: 20 years ago, a tragic accident on Valentine's Day took the lives of 5 miners when supervisors left their posts to attend a Valentine's Day dance. On the disaster's first anniversary, the only survivor returns to the town for bloody revenge

programme.title: Messiah Of Evil
programme.desc: A woman arrives in a seaside town after receiving unsettling letters from her father, only to discover it's under the influence of a strange cult.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Big Jake
programme.desc: An aging Texas cattle man who has outlived his time swings into action when outlaws kidnap his grandson and wound his son.

programme.title: The Crow: City of Angels
programme.desc: This fast-moving, action-packed sequel to THE CROW follows the rise of murder victim Ashe Corven, brought back to life by a mysterious crow. With the help of a woman named Sarah, he exacts revenge on his killers one by one.

programme.title: The Crow: Salvation
programme.desc: Alex Corvis returns to the world of the living to solve the murder of a young woman that he was wrongly accused of.

programme.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
programme.desc: To his classmates and teachers, high-schooler Ben Manibag appears to be the model student: a perfectionist and overachiever. But underneath this persona is a darker side. Ben and his bored high-school buddies lead double lives.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Anna

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Gridiron Gang
programme.desc: Sean Porter (Johnson) is a frustrated probation officer, as most of the kids he oversees end up back in prison or dead. Desperate to make a difference, he devises a plan to teach discipline and responsibility through football.

programme.title: Kickboxer III (The Art Of War)
programme.desc: David Sloan (Mitchell ) travels to Rio de Janeiro where the action is hotter, the women sexier, and the competition deadlier than ever before.

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: The Aggressor
programme.desc: David Sloan is on a mission to free his wife who has been enslaved by an evil world champion, Tong Po. He attempts to gain entry into Po’s savage kingdom by fighting in the tournament of champions where the winner takes all.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: The story of a minor-league North Carolina baseball team (the Triple A Durham Bulls) and its attentive, intelligent groupie who feels it is her mission to live with one young player per season and help him mature.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Child 44
programme.desc: Exiled secret police officer Leo Demidov (Tom Hardy) discovers a serial killer and suspects his superiors of covering it up. It is up to Leo to stop the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Texas is at the mercy of murderous bandits. A group of unlikely heroes emerges to battle these renegade outlaws. Out-manned, they summon the courage to protect the innocent and put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal, and to restore order to his world.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle, where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
programme.desc: There’s a mad bomber on board, the first lunar shuttle is about to self-destruct, the engines are not working, and worst of all, the flight crew discovers they are completely out of coffee!

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: When Jack Deebs was behind bars he found escape by creating Cool World, a cartoon series featuring a vixen named Holli Would. The flesh proves weaker than ink, however, as Holli takes human form in Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II

programme.title: London Has Fallen

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Big Happy Family
programme.desc: When Shirley receives distressing news about her health, it’s up to her Aunt Madea to gather the clan and make things right the only way she knows how: with tough love and laughter.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

programme.title: The Redemption: Kickboxer 5
programme.desc: A retired kickboxer goes on a mission to avenge the brutal death of his promising young student. Revenge is not easy, however, as the target of his wrath is a leader of an underworld kickboxing league.

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a married workaholic is given a universal remote that lets him pause, rewind, or skip past parts of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Michelle Pfeiffer plays Frankie, a waitress at a N.Y.C. coffee shop. After a series of hurtful relationships, the last thing Frankie’s looking for is a new man...until he comes looking for her.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: From the best-selling book series comes a fantasy adventure that reveals the unseen world all around us.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Pretty Woman
programme.desc: Julia Roberts and Richard Gere star in an irresistible comedy hit.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: In the third creature feature in the MIMIC franchise, the bugs are back. After a group of people begins to disappear, a man hypersensitive to germs and confined to a protective bubble, decides to play detective.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Airplane!
programme.desc: Voted “one of the 10 funniest movies ever made” by the American Film Institute, “Airplane!” is a masterpiece of off-the-wall comedy.

programme.title: Messiah Of Evil
programme.desc: A woman arrives in a seaside town after receiving unsettling letters from her father, only to discover it's under the influence of a strange cult.

programme.title: Dead & Buried
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening in the quiet coastal village of Potters Bluff, where tourists and transients are warmly welcomed... then brutally murdered. But even more shocking is when these slain strangers reappear as normal citizens around town.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Rio Lobo
programme.desc: This fifth and final collaboration between John Wayne and director Howard Hawks is an action-filled Western set after the Civil War, in which a group of men seek out Union traitors responsible for a string of train robbers.

programme.title: Big Jake
programme.desc: An aging Texas cattle man who has outlived his time swings into action when outlaws kidnap his grandson and wound his son.

programme.title: Shin Ultraman
programme.desc: A silver giant descends from the sky to rescue the planet. Dubbed Ultraman, this giant's identity and purpose are a mystery.

programme.title: Hellboy

She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Dwayne Perkins
programme.desc: Dwayne Perkins has earned a spot in today's elite class of stand-up comics with appearances on Comedy Central and on Conan. He's getting a lot of buzz for his recurring piece on The Jay Leno Show entitled "Great White Moments in Black History." Dwayne's Comedy Central half-hour special, a culmination of his talent and hard work, was very well received. It showcases his way of looking at life and his ability to convey it in a hilarious manner. Dwayne can be seen in the HBO movie The Gristle. Dwayne has also appeared in several commercials pushing products for The Man. Dwayne is part of The Bob & Tom Comedy Tour in addition to headlining colleges and comedy clubs across the country.

programme.title: Danny Johnson
programme.desc: Danny Johnson's hilarious, clean stand-up has entertained audiences in comedy clubs, corporate events, and churches nationwide. Often called a cross between Jerry Seinfeld and Kevin James Danny's show is relatable, engaging, and always hilarious. Danny has starred in numerous TV commercials, Comedy Central's Laugh Riots, Florida's Funniest Comedian semi-finalist, Winner-Carnival Cruise line Comedy Challenge, Finalist in Search for the One Christian Comedy contest, and has had the pleasure of sharing the stage with Chris Rock, Bob Saget, Billy Gardell, Richard Lewis, and a variety of others. Danny has led a dual track career for over a decade achieving success in both corporate America and as a comedian. Blending his unique skill sets led to him publishing his first book, "You Stink and They Know It! A practical guide to nailing your next job interview."

programme.title: Kim Kerley
programme.desc: Having spent much of her teens homeless, Kim Kerley has seen things in life that many never see. She's chosen to find the funny in those situations. A keen observer of life's crazy conditions, her comedy comes from real life. A regular on San Antonio Living, Kim has been performing stand-up comedy for over 13 years. She has traveled extensively in the U.S. and abroad, including an inspiring stint with Armed Forces Entertainment. She was also an actress with the comedy group, Laff Stock. She is an actor with Dramatic Diva Productions, putting on community plays in the San Antonio area. Kim also performed comedy on “The View”. She helmed San Antonio's number 2 drive-time morning radio show. She also handled production duties for Cox Media in San Antonio and was also on the Y-100 morning show. She has shared the stages with comedy greats like Carlos Mencia, Ron White, Lewis Black and many others.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
